evidence.sourceTitle: King Bahanzin of Dahomey, West Africa, smoking a pipe. Wood-engraving.

title.en: Dahomey: royal compounds and a changing Atlantic world
title.zh: 达荷美王国：王宫建筑与变化的大西洋世界

summary.en:
Dahomey developed around Abomey, where successive rulers built royal compounds. Palaces and their reliefs preserve claims about succession, warfare and the responsibilities of kingship. Their imagery was part of how royal history was communicated and remembered.

The kingdom belonged to the political and commercial world of the Atlantic coast, including warfare and the trafficking of enslaved people. French conquest ended independent royal power in the 1890s, while palace traditions and community memories continued. Royal heritage must therefore be read alongside the experiences of people subjected to coercion, rather than only as a record of court achievement.
summary.zh:
达荷美以阿波美为中心发展，历代统治者修建自己的王宫院落。宫殿与浮雕保存关于继承、战争和君主责任的表达。这些图像参与传达和记忆王室历史。

王国属于大西洋沿岸政治与贸易世界，其间涉及战争和被奴役人口贩运。19世纪90年代法国征服终结独立王权，但宫廷传统与社区记忆仍延续。因此王室遗产必须与遭受强制者的经历一同阅读，而不能只呈现为宫廷成就记录。

dateNote.en: 1625–1894 is a qualified independent-kingdom interval; UNESCO’s palace succession runs to 1900 and must not be mistaken for sovereignty lasting to that date. The 1890s conquest and later dynastic continuity are distinct.
dateNote.zh: 1625—1894年为有保留的独立王国时段；联合国教科文组织的王宫君主继承表延至1900年，不能被误读为主权一直延续到该年。19世纪90年代征服与后来王室延续需要区分。

evidence.sourceTitle: Henry Brougham is praised by black ex-slaves for his part in their liberation, but criticized by children factory employees, on whom he turns his back. Lithograph by H.H. (Henry Heath).
evidence.sourceDescription:
The ex-slaves are saying "Ah! Massa Bro'am! You be poor Negro best friend. We no like work; climate too hot, poor negro too fat - ha! ha! ha!". Brougham says "Poor unhappy negro! I have caused twenty millions of money, taken from the pockets of my fellow countrymen, to be spent in purchasing your freedom, but am woefully disappointed in its mis-application." The factory children are saying "Cruel Lord! to turn his back on us poor factory children."

"Throughout his life Brougham continued to speak out, in parliament and in public, against the evils of the slave trade and slavery, and he remained proud of his own contribution to the cause of the abolitionists" (Oxford dictionary of national biography). In the print, Brougham wears tartan trews: the ODNB says that in the 1830s "Many began to comment that the often dishevelled-looking Brougham was not entirely of sound mind. He began to sport tartan trousers, buying enough material to last for the rest of his life"

title.en: 1833: child labour rules acquire an inspectorate

labelI18n.zh: 曼彻斯特；纺织工业背景的代表地点

summary.en:
The 1833 Factory Act placed age and working-hour restrictions on children in specified textile factories and required schooling for younger workers. Its reach was limited: a statute about particular industries was not a ban on every form of child labor. Campaigns, inquiries and earlier legislation formed the background to the measure.

An inspectorate gave the government a new means of checking compliance, but four inspectors could not supervise thousands of mills continuously. Evasion therefore remained part of the law’s early history. This case shows why a reform’s passage and its effects on daily life need separate evidence. Children’s wages mattered to households, while employers and reformers disputed hours, education and industrial costs. Placing the act beside inventions and industrial landscapes keeps workers and institutions visible within the history of technological change.
summary.zh:
1833年《工厂法》对特定纺织工厂中儿童的年龄和工时设限，并要求较年幼工人接受教育。它的适用范围有限：针对某些行业的法规，并不等于禁止一切形式的童工。社会运动、调查和此前立法，共同构成这项措施的背景。

监察制度为政府提供了检查执行的新手段，但四名监察员无法持续监管数千家工厂，因此规避规定仍是该法早期历史的一部分。这个案例说明，改革通过与日常生活实际改变，需要分别寻找证据。儿童工资关系到家庭生计，雇主和改革者则争论工时、教育及工业成本。把法规与发明、工业景观并列，能使劳动者及制度在技术变迁史中保持可见。

dateNote.en: 1833 marks passage, not full enforcement. Manchester is an industrial reference rather than the legislative seat.
dateNote.zh: 1833年指法律通过，并非完全落实；曼彻斯特为工业参照点，并非立法所在地。

title.en: British emancipation: law, compensation and apprenticeship
title.zh: 英国殖民地解放：法律、赔偿与学徒制

location.label: Westminster, London; legislative reference, not the Caribbean communities affected

labelI18n.en: Westminster, London; legislative reference, not the Caribbean communities affected
labelI18n.zh: 伦敦威斯敏斯特；立法背景的参考位置，并非受影响的加勒比社群所在地

summary.en: Parliament’s 1833 Slavery Abolition Act began a staged legal transition in much of Britain’s colonial empire. In the British Caribbean, formal emancipation in 1834 was commonly followed by compulsory apprenticeship, which kept many formerly enslaved people working for their former enslavers. The state arranged compensation for slaveholders, not equivalent restitution to the people they had enslaved. Parliamentary debate in 1838 records pressure to end the coercive system, and apprenticeship ended that year. The sequence separates legislation from lived freedom and makes clear why a single abolition date can mislead. It also belongs to a broader Atlantic history of resistance, abolition campaigns and unequal labor arrangements.
summary.zh: 英国议会1833年的《废除奴隶制法》在殖民帝国大部分地区启动了分阶段的法律转变。在英属加勒比，1834年的形式解放之后，许多获得解放的人仍被强制纳入学徒制，为原奴隶主劳动。国家为奴隶主安排赔偿，而未向曾被奴役者提供对等补偿。1838年的议会辩论记录了终止这种强制制度的压力，学徒制也在当年结束。这一过程区分了法律颁布与实际自由，说明为何单一的废奴年份容易误导。它同时属于更广泛的大西洋反抗、废奴运动和不平等劳动安排的历史。

dateNote.en: 1833 is the Act; 1 August 1834 marks formal Caribbean emancipation, followed in many colonies by apprenticeship until 1 August 1838. Exceptions and local implementation varied. Westminster is the legislative reference point.
dateNote.zh: 1833年为法律通过；1834年8月1日标示加勒比地区形式解放，许多殖民地的学徒制持续至1838年8月1日。例外情况与地方实施并不一致。威斯敏斯特代表立法地点。

sources.title: The West Indian colonies and emancipation
sources.evidenceNote: Institutional history identifies the 1833 Act, planter compensation, 1834 emancipation and 1838 end of apprenticeship; local exceptions are not collapsed into a single date.

sources.title: Slavery Abolition Act — House of Commons debate, 6 April 1838
sources.evidenceNote: Primary parliamentary debate documents arguments over ending apprenticeship, including conditions in Jamaica; speakers’ claims are treated as debate evidence, not neutral observation.

en: The Act, formal emancipation and the end of apprenticeship were separate stages.
Compensation went to slaveholders rather than the people they had enslaved.
zh: 法律通过、形式解放与学徒制终结是不同阶段。
赔偿付给奴隶主，而不是曾被他们奴役的人。

relationship.en: Heath’s satire places colonial emancipation and factory children in competing groups around Brougham. The speech bubbles attack his priorities through racist caricature, rather than recording the people’s own testimony. The catalogue’s tentative year is retained as uncertain; this is evidence of argument over reform, not a dated picture of the 1833 legislation.
relationship.zh: 希思的讽刺画把殖民地解放与工厂童工分置于布鲁厄姆两侧。对白借助种族主义丑化来攻击他的政策取舍，并非图中人物自己的证言。馆藏暂定年份仍保留为不确定；它是关于改革争论的材料，不是对1833年立法现场的记录。

title.en: The transatlantic slave trade · Records, coercion and resistance
title.zh: 跨大西洋奴隶贸易 · 档案、强制与抵抗

location.label: West African coast; an illustrative regional point, not a source for every voyage

labelI18n.en: West African coast; an illustrative regional point, not a source for every voyage
labelI18n.zh: 西非海岸；说明区域的地点，并非每次航行的起点

summary.en:
Over centuries, merchants and states organized voyages that forcibly carried enslaved Africans across the Atlantic. The trade connected many African embarkation regions with different destinations in the Americas; it cannot be reduced to one port, one route or one institution. Enslaved people resisted in many ways, and surviving communities created family and cultural lives despite the violence.

SlaveVoyages assembles evidence from many surviving records and estimates missing information where sources are incomplete. Its documented 1514–1866 range describes records discussed by the database, not the beginning or end of enslavement everywhere. The linked Atlantic journey is a schematic network, not a reconstructed voyage for any individual. Read it with Caribbean plantation work, Palmares, Mary Prince and Haiti to see different experiences and forms of resistance.
summary.zh:
数百年间，商人与国家组织航行，将被奴役的非洲人强行运过大西洋。贸易把非洲多个登船地区同美洲不同目的地相连，不能简化成一个港口、一条路线或一种制度。被奴役者以多种方式抵抗，幸存社群在暴力条件下仍建立家庭与文化生活。

SlaveVoyages汇集许多幸存档案，并在材料缺失处估计未知信息。其所述1514—1866年记录范围只是数据库讨论的范围，不是各地奴役制度的起止。配套大西洋旅程是网络示意，并非某个人的重建航线。结合加勒比种植园劳动、帕尔马雷斯、玛丽·普林斯和海地，可以看到不同经历与抵抗方式。

dateNote.en: 1514–1866 is the documented voyage span discussed in the cited database essay. The atlas’s existing journey uses the broader 1501–1866 editorial window. Neither range defines the start or end of all enslavement or its consequences.
dateNote.zh: 1514—1866年是所引数据库文章讨论的有文献航行范围；图集中现有旅程采用较宽的1501—1866年编辑窗口。两个范围均不能定义全部奴役及其后果的起止。

sources.title: The Trans-Atlantic Slave Trade Database
sources.evidenceNote: Directly inspected the methods essay: documented voyages 1514–1866, uneven archival survival, imputed variables and model estimates. Database coverage is not the entire history of slavery.

sources.title: The slave trade and slavery: a founding tragedy of our modern world
sources.evidenceNote: Directly inspected the essay on enslavement, resistance and enduring consequences. Broad Africa-wide estimates are not combined with the database’s transatlantic estimates.

reviewLimit.en: The database gives model estimates and uneven surviving records; no single digit or point represents every person or route.
reviewLimit.zh: 数据库包含模型估算与保存不均的档案；单个数字或地点不能代表每个人及每条路线。

relationship.en: The Illustrated London News based this engraving on a naval officer’s sketch of the Emilia’s capture off Cuba. The 1858 image shows the continuing Atlantic trade long after Britain’s abolition of its own slave trade, while its ship-centred viewpoint leaves the transported people largely out of sight.
relationship.zh: 《伦敦新闻画报》依据一名海军军官的速写，刻画“埃米利亚”号在古巴近海被截获的场景。这幅1858年的图像呈现英国废除本国奴隶贸易多年后仍在继续的大西洋贩运；以舰船为中心的视角，却让被运送者几乎不可见。

evidence.visualReview: Full 1000×651 derivative inspected. Ship rigging, vessels, boats and source caption Capture of a slaver off the coast of Cuba visible. Identity and 1858 date verified in catalogue and quoted Illustrated London News provenance.

evidence.sourceTitle: City of Lahore with Ranjit Singh in foreground, Punjab, Pakistan. Coloured transfer lithograph.

title.en: Sikh kingdom: uniting power in the Punjab
title.zh: 锡克王国：旁遮普的政治整合

summary.en:
Under Ranjit Singh, a Sikh kingdom took shape in the Punjab at the turn of the nineteenth century. Lahore became the center of a state that joined territories and military resources previously divided among competing powers. Its history belongs beside Company expansion, not merely as a preface to British rule.

The kingdom’s political lifespan ended with annexation after the Anglo-Sikh wars, while Sikh communities and religious institutions continued. Studying this interval alongside Mughal decline and British expansion helps distinguish a regional political project from the much longer history of a religion and its people.
summary.zh:
19世纪之交，兰季特·辛格领导下的锡克王国在旁遮普成形。拉合尔成为政治中心，将先前由不同势力掌握的土地和军事资源整合起来。它应与东印度公司的扩张并列研究，而非仅作为英国统治的前奏。

英锡战争后的兼并终结了王国的政治存在，但锡克社区与宗教机构继续发展。把这一时期放在莫卧儿衰落和英国扩张之间，可以区分一个区域国家工程与宗教及民众更长久的历史。

dateNote.en: 1799–1849 follows the British Museum and the Cambridge dynastic chapter. Ranjit Singh’s capture of Lahore anchors the start; his royal coronation was later. The point is Lahore, not the kingdom’s changing borders.
dateNote.zh: 1799—1849年采用大英博物馆与剑桥王国史章节的分期。起点锚定兰季特·辛格占领拉合尔，其正式加冕在后。点位为拉合尔，不表示王国不断变化的边界。

alt.en: Brougham faces a group of Black figures while children beside a smoking factory appeal to him from behind.
alt.zh: 布鲁厄姆面朝一群黑人形象，身后冒烟工厂旁的儿童向他呼吁。

caption.en: Henry Heath places Brougham between racist caricatures of emancipated people and protesting factory children.
caption.zh: 亨利·希思把布鲁厄姆置于遭种族主义丑化的获解放者形象与抗议的工厂儿童之间。

interpretation.en: The speech bubbles make emancipation and factory reform competing claims on attention. They express the satirist’s argument, not the depicted people’s testimony. The tentative catalogue date, 1832?, conflicts with the reference to compensation under the 1833 abolition legislation; the year remains unresolved.
interpretation.zh: 对白把殖民地解放与工厂改革表现为争夺关注的诉求。这是讽刺画作者的论点，不是图中人物的证言。馆藏暂定的1832年？与画中涉及1833年废奴立法赔偿的文字冲突，年份仍未确定。

alt.en: Women and children stand beside large carding machines, driving belts and tall cylindrical containers.
alt.zh: 妇女与儿童站在大型梳棉机、传动带和高筒形容器旁。

caption.en: Women and children operate cotton-carding machines in this 1840 print after J. R. Barfoot.
caption.zh: 这幅1840年依据J.R.巴富特作品制作的版画，描绘妇女与儿童操作梳棉机。

interpretation.en: Belts and cylinders organize a sequence of tasks performed by the workers. The later print shows the workplace addressed by factory reform, while working hours and enforcement require written records.
interpretation.zh: 传动带与滚筒组织起工人完成的一系列操作。这幅较晚的版画呈现工厂改革所针对的劳动场所，工时与执法情况则需结合文字档案。

在古巴近海截获“埃米利亚”号

alt.en: Several sailing ships and small boats gather around a large vessel beneath a clouded sky.
alt.zh: 多艘帆船和小艇聚集在一艘大船周围，天空布满云层。

caption.en: An 1858 engraving shows the Royal Navy intercepting the slave ship Emilia off Cuba, after an officer’s sketch.
caption.zh: 1858年版画依据军官速写，描绘英国海军在古巴近海截获贩奴船“埃米利亚”号。

interpretation.en: The ships dominate the composition; the people being transported are almost invisible. This naval view documents an Atlantic trade that continued after Britain abolished its own slave trade.
interpretation.zh: 舰船占据构图中心，被运送者几乎不可见。这幅海军视角的图像记录了英国废除本国奴隶贸易后仍在继续的大西洋贩运。

alt.en: A coloured panorama labels Lahore’s citadel and royal mosque above a small mounted procession.
alt.zh: 彩色全景在小型骑乘队伍上方，标注拉合尔的城堡与皇家清真寺。

caption.en: An undated northern view of Lahore places Ranjit Singh, identified by the catalogue, in the foreground.
caption.zh: 未纪年的拉合尔北面景观把馆藏所辨识的兰季特·辛格置于前景。

interpretation.en: Named buildings extend across the skyline while a small procession occupies the foreground. The composition links the ruler with the kingdom’s urban capital.
interpretation.zh: 具名建筑沿天际线延伸，前景则是一支小队伍。构图把统治者同王国都城连接起来。
